records.text: Let's show another one. Uh, 'Why is the news covering for mother murderers? Stop calling her a homeowner. Call her what she is. She was their mother and is charged with killing her kids.' Like that person just seems like the standard mom that you meet, okay? Next one: 'Vivian (child in quoted news story; surname unverified) was four years old. A judge ruled that she was going home to her dad and she never made it there.' Again, shared by the New York Post. Okay, give me another one: 'Not only did she stab her kid 50 times, but she took a baseball bat to them.'
records.speaker: Candace Owens
